description: INDEPENDENT ORACLE (computed by hand from the XML, NOT from the importer). Opening balances (Capital Cr 100000, Cash A/c Dr 40000, Opening Stock Dr 60000) + four trading vouchers. NOTE: the cash ledger is named 'Cash A/c' (not the pre-seeded system 'Cash') so the opening balance from the LEDGER master folds in; an opening on the seeded 'Cash' would be dropped by resolve-first (importer follow-up). Per-ledger running balance: Cash A/c = 40000(open) +30000(sale) -18000(purc) -5000(rent) +2000(comm) = 49000 Dr. Capital = 100000 Cr. Opening Stock = 60000 Dr. Sales = 30000 Cr. Purchases = 18000 Dr. Rent = 5000 Dr. Commission Received = 2000 Cr. TB: SUM Dr = 49000+60000+18000+5000 = 132000; SUM Cr = 100000+30000+2000 = 132000 (balanced). P&L: Income = Sales 30000 + Commission 2000 = 32000; Expense = Purchases 18000 + Rent 5000 = 23000; NetProfit = 32000-23000 = 9000. BS: Assets = Cash A/c 49000 + Opening Stock 60000 = 109000; Liabilities = Capital 100000 + NetProfit 9000 = 109000 (balanced). BS.NetProfit == PL.NetProfit == 9000. No GST.
